ROUND-2 EVIDENCE: new test 4 'Counter-collect CASH confirm POSTs with X-Idempotency-Key + row disappears' (spec line 270) seeds a fresh PENDING_COUNTER kiosk-cash order via seed-kiosk-cash-pending.js, arms waitForRequest + waitForResponse on the POST .../confirm BEFORE clicking, asserts X-Idempotency-Key header matches `^pos-counter-collect-${id}-\d+-\d+$` (the documented formula), asserts body {mode: 1 (CASH), received >= prefilled total}, asserts confirm response < 300 (with explicit error-surfacing throw on >=300, not silent), asserts modal hides, then awaits a /pending GET that fires AFTER the confirm response (closure-tracked timestamp) and verifies the seeded order id is no longer in the data array. Network.json for state 08 is empty `[]` (no 4xx/5xx, recorder only logs status>=400 or duration>2000ms — confirms the confirm POST returned 2xx cleanly).

ROUND-2 EVIDENCE: grep -c '\.catch(' returns 3 (was 6+ at round-1). Remaining 3 occurrences are: (a) line 56 — a COMMENT in the docblock describing what was removed, (b) line 334 — a fire-and-forget on a side-effect closure that mirrors confirmCompletedAt timestamp, body of catch is empty by design (the same promise IS awaited elsewhere with hard error surfacing on line 361), (c) line 363 — `.text().catch(() => '<no body>')` on an ALREADY-non-OK response while building the error message, which is acceptable defensive code (the spec is already throwing). The new centralised waitForCashPending() (lines 58-65) throws on 5xx or 30s hang — no more silent green-skip on endpoint failure. POS_WAVE_X_REQUIRE_SEED=1 escape hatch documented to hard-fail empty-DB on CI.
